description: This source file defines API routes related to authentication including user registration, login, token retrieval, and fetching current user info using FastAPI framework.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object for grouping related API endpoints.

methods.name: UserRead register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint to register a new user with name, email, and password.

methods.name: Token login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: API endpoint to authenticate a user and provide a JWT access token.

methods.name: Token oauth_token(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: OAuth2 token endpoint accepting form credentials for token issuance.

methods.name: UserRead me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch the profile of the current authenticated user.
